synopsis: Foretellix spans on-road validation and off-road offerings: the vendor sells a Level-4 Mining V-Suite, and its March 2021 Volvo Autonomous Solutions partnership aimed to adapt verification for confined areas such as mines and quarries [f8626, f8625, f8692]. Its data platforms ingest logs, derive scenarios and manage regression testing, but compatibility with the eventual sensors’ raw data must be checked [f8658, f8659]. In an anonymous on-road Level 4 developer case, Foretellix reports six months of process change, scenario coverage rising from 12% to 87%, and projected development falling from about 4.5 years to under two years [f1302, f1303]. These are vendor-authored, independently unverified claims with undisclosed staffing, validation duration after capability became available, and remaining physical testing; acceptance was internal or customer-level rather than external safety acceptance [f1304, f1559, f1789, f1309, f1790]. Foretellix appears in the highest-cost example commercial tool chain for coverage-driven scenario management, and its Series C closed at USD 85 million in December 2023 [f9303, f8623].
